title: Authored example: Discussion of scholarly policy
text: The court discussed the selection of scholars and the duties of the Hall of Worthies. Officials proposed that learned men should study historical precedents and advise the king.

title: Authored example: Appointment of scholars
text: Several scholars were appointed to offices associated with royal study. The record names the appointment and describes their responsibility to prepare learned discussion.

title: Authored example: Promulgation associated with the new script
text: A record describes the publication of the Correct Sounds for the Instruction of the People and explains its purpose for people who could not readily express themselves in writing.
